title: In Splunk Enterprise versions below 10.6.0, 10.4.5, 10.2.9, 10.0.12, and 9.4.17, a user who does not hold a role with…
description: Splunk Enterprise versions below 10.6.0, 10.4.5, 10.2.9, 10.0.12, and 9.4.17 contain a vulnerability where users lacking the list_indexer_cluster or edit_indexer_cluster capabilities can download the cluster manager configuration bundle via the REST API. This bundle includes configuration and app files staged for indexer distribution. The flaw exists because the REST API does not enforce capability checks before providing access to this bundle.
